<script>
const CORRECT_HASH = "ac95cc34e3ff9d4e59fd3066f6feaee0d2f4f7f97d3865148bc5767834883ff5";

async function sha256(msg) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}

async function checkPw() {
  const hash = await sha256(document.getElementById("pw-input").value);
  if (hash === CORRECT_HASH) {
    document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("scripts-content").style.display = "block";
    sessionStorage.setItem("rscripts_unlocked", "1");
  } else {
    const err = document.getElementById("pw-error");
    err.textContent = "Incorrect password. Please try again.";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").value = "";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").focus();
    setTimeout(() => { err.textContent = ""; }, 3000);
  }
}

if (sessionStorage.getItem("rscripts_unlocked") === "1") {
  document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("scripts-content").style.display = "block";
}

// ── Upload helpers ──────────────────────────────────
function showFileName(input) {
  document.getElementById("file-name").textContent =
    input.files.length ? "📎 " + input.files[0].name : "";
}
const dropZone = document.getElementById("drop-zone");
if (dropZone) {
  dropZone.addEventListener("dragover", e => { e.preventDefault(); dropZone.classList.add("drag-over"); });
  dropZone.addEventListener("dragleave", () => dropZone.classList.remove("drag-over"));
  dropZone.addEventListener("drop", e => {
    e.preventDefault(); dropZone.classList.remove("drag-over");
    const fi = document.getElementById("file-input");
    fi.files = e.dataTransfer.files; showFileName(fi);
  });
  dropZone.addEventListener("click", () => document.getElementById("file-input").click());
}
const uploadForm = document.getElementById("upload-form");
if (uploadForm) {
  uploadForm.addEventListener("submit", async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const status = document.getElementById("upload-status");
    const btn = uploadForm.querySelector(".upload-btn");
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Sending…";
    try {
      const res = await fetch(uploadForm.action, {
        method: "POST", body: new FormData(uploadForm),
        headers: { "Accept": "application/json" }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        status.style.color = "#27ae60";
        status.textContent = "✔ Script submitted successfully. Thank you!";
        uploadForm.reset();
        document.getElementById("file-name").textContent = "";
      } else { throw new Error(); }
    } catch {
      status.style.color = "#c0392b";
      status.textContent = "✘ Submission failed. Please try again or contact me directly.";
    }
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-paper-plane"></i> &nbsp;Send';
  });
}
</script>
